status: computed — held-out correlation, mean of 12 random match splits
summary: Headline test: how well each method, built from one random half of the matches, predicts a player's win-probability impact under pressure in the other half (mean of 12 splits). Bowlers: my blend vs raw economy is 0.14 vs 0.10 on win impact, 0.09 vs 0.03 on runs above expected and 0.18 vs 0.06 on opposition-adjusted skill. Batters: my blend vs raw strike rate is 0.21 vs 0.18 on win impact, 0.26 vs 0.26 on runs above expected and 0.36 vs 0.26 on opposition-adjusted skill. Read these as an honest comparison, not a claim of superiority: where raw strike rate or economy scores higher on raw outcomes, the blend's value is fairness to opposition quality and explicit uncertainty (rank ranges, P(top 10)).
